problemBlurb: Many non-speaking people in Sri Lanka struggle to reach a caregiver quickly. Sahaaya lets them select a phrase, have it spoken aloud in Sinhala, Tamil or English, and instantly notify a linked caregiver who can respond. It is not speech therapy, diagnosis, or an emergency service.
emailHelpCaregiver: Requests are emailed here, in addition to your live dashboard.
accessCodeHelp: Enter the code your caregiver gave you — no name or phone needed.
accessCodeCreatedHint: Give this code to the patient's device now — it won't be shown again.
invalidPairingCode: That pairing code is invalid or already used.
chooseAccessMode: How would you like to communicate?
touchModeDesc: Tap a phrase, review it, then confirm and send.
faceModeDesc: Hands-free: a long blink or held mouth-open selects a highlighted card, then nod to confirm.
cameraPrivacyNote: Camera processing stays on this device. No image is ever uploaded.
noActiveCaregiver: No active caregiver yet — pair with one from the Caregivers tab.
